challenge.method: Checked every verb, who receives the permission, the downstream permission, and the qualifier following it. Tested whether “without restriction” establishes an unconditional grant or resolves patent rights.
challenge.results: The enumeration and downstream permission are express. “Subject to the following conditions” qualifies them. The text contains no express patent grant, and its silence leaves implied patent rights unresolved.

limitations: A particular work’s coverage, the grantor’s authority, third-party rights, and implied patent rights require separate evidence.
